title: Bambu Lab AMS Feed Failure Count
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bambulab:job
| stats count(eval(event="ams_feed_fail")) as ams_feed_failures by printer
| where ams_feed_failures>0
| sort - ams_feed_failures
description: Uses Bambu Lab print jobs telemetry to monitor automatic-material-system feed failures by printer in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for AMS paths that need cleanup or parts before a larger job fails, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Bambu Lab print jobs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Printer table of AMS feed failures.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces automatic-material-system feed failures by printer so you can spot AMS paths that need cleanup or parts before a larger job fails before it becomes annoying.
